subject: Gerudo Valley
text: Breaking the rocks near the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley reveals a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Break all the rocks here to reveal a chest. Open it for a 
PURPLE RUPEE, if you need some money.

subject: Gerudo's Fortress
text: Above the cell in Gerudo's Fortress, Longshot to the treasure chest to obtain a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
You're now above your cell. Smash the crate for a Purple Rupee, and look to
the left. Longshot to the treasure chest and open it for a Piece of Heart.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula can be seen at night on the cliff side above the southern drop in Gerudo's Fortress.

evidence.quote:
Get to the southern cliff wall, and drop down on
the south side. Look up at the cliff side to see a Gold Skulltula at night.

subject: Gerudo Thief
text: Defeating the Gerudo thief that guards the first carpenter drops a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Either way, once she's beaten, she'll drop a SMALL 
KEY. Use it to free the carpenter.

subject: Gerudo Thief
text: Defeating the Gerudo guard in the northern hallway drops a Small Key used to free the second carpenter.

evidence.quote:
Head into the northern hallway here and you'll find another carpenter locked
up. Talk to him and another guard will drop down. Defeat her in the same way
to get a SMALL KEY, and use it to free the carpenter.

subject: Gerudo Guard
text: After freeing all four carpenters, a Gerudo guard gives Link the Gerudo's Membership Card.

evidence.quote:
Free him, and you'll see a Gerudo guard 
watching you. She says that she's been watching you all this time, and she's 
impressed at your stealth skills, so she decides to make you an official member 
of the Gerudo by giving you a Membership Card.

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Hitting the eye switch above the entrance stairs in Gerudo Training Grounds spawns a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
In this
mini dungeon, climb up the stairs, turn around, and fire an arrow at the eye
switch for a chest containing a BLUE RUPEE.

subject: Stalfos Room
text: Defeating two Stalfos in under a minute spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Inside, you 
have to fight two Stalfos in under a minute. Be quick. After defeating them, a 
chest with a SMALL KEY appears.

subject: Silver Rupee Room
text: The boulder challenge room in Gerudo Training Grounds requires collecting all Silver Rupees within 1 minute and 30 seconds.

evidence.quote: Your next challenge is to collect all the Silver Rupees in under 1:30 minutes.

subject: Statue Room
text: Hitting all of the statue's eyes with the Bow causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear.

evidence.quote:
In here, jump onto the platform below and hit all the statue's eyes with the 
Bow. Doing this will make a chest with a SMALL KEY appear.

subject: Statue Perimeter Room
text: Smashing statues with the Megaton Hammer uncovers a switch that lowers fire around a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Smash away all the statues with the Megaton Hammer to
find a gold eye switch and a ground switch. Step on the ground switch to lower
the fire in the center. Quickly get the SMALL KEY inside the chest the fire
was protecting, then hit the eye switch with an Arrow.

subject: Underwater Silver Rupee Room
text: Collecting all the Silver Rupees underwater in the pool reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Once you have
them, rise to the top, collect the SMALL KEY inside the chest, and head back to
the lava room.

subject: Dinolfos and Beamos Room
text: Defeating two Dinolfos and bombing the Beamos in the timed room rewards a Small Key from a chest.

evidence.quote:
Inside you'll fight two Dinalfos. Kill them quickly with the Biggoron's Sword,
and bomb the Beamos to clear this timed room.  Collect the SMALL KEY from the
chest.

subject: Lava Room
text: Playing the Song of Time at the ledge button creates blocks allowing Link to climb up and grab a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Get to the ledge with the button and play 
the Song of Time to make some blocks appear. Climb up them, grab the SMALL 
KEY, and head through the opening.

subject: Treasure Room
text: Opening the front chest in the central treasure room yields a Bombchu.

evidence.quote:
We're now in the room that contains the treasure we're looking for, but we
can't get to it yet. Open the chest in front of you for a BOMBCHU, and then
open the chest to the right (when you enter) for some Arrows.

subject: Treasure Room
text: Passing through two locked doors starting on the left leads to a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Go through two locked doors starting at the left, and open the 
chest for a PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: Treasure Room
text: Continuing through the locked doors of the treasure room leads to a chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Continue through until you reach another chest with a 
RED RUPEE.

subject: Treasure Room Ceiling
text: Using the Lens of Truth inside the first locked room reveals a ceiling hole containing a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
OK, backtrack 
to the small room you enter when you go through the first locked door from this 
area's entrance, and use the Lens of Truth to find a hole in the ceiling.  
Climb up to it and collect the SMALL KEY in the chest.

subject: Treasure Room
text: Unlocking the final locked door in the central treasure room grants the Ice Arrows from the chest.

evidence.quote:
Head back to the last 
locked door and open the chest for the ICE ARROWS.

subject: Like Like Room
text: Pushing the huge block with the Silver Gauntlets and defeating all Like Likes spawns a chest with a Huge Rupee and another with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Using the Silver Gauntlets from the Spirit Temple, push this huge block until
it drops. Head through the door to encounter a room infested with Like Likes.
Kill them all with the Biggoron's Sword and two chests will appear. One has a
HUGE RUPEE and the other has a BLUE RUPEE.

subject: Like Like Room
text: Using the Lens of Truth in the Like Like room reveals a hidden final chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Ignore the chest on the ledge 
(it'll freeze you if you open it) and use the Lens of Truth to find the final 
chest in here, which contains this last key.
